coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult (12 months to 21 years; stdAges CHILD, ADULT) multi-tumour Phase I; glioblastoma (IDH-wildtype or IDH-mutant) explicitly eligible in the HGG cohort inclusion criteria -> basket_gbm_eligible, basket true; explicitly allows IDH-mutant glioblastoma -> historical. Ribociclib is the only investigational agent, added to TOTEM (topotecan + temozolomide) backbone; temozolomide starting dose was reduced from 150 to 100 mg/m2/day in later cohorts, a backbone adjustment rather than the question, so soc_backbone. Plasma-only PK. SMARCB1 loss is a diagnostic criterion for the rhabdoid cohort only (enrichment, not candidate matched); MYCN status must merely be available for neuroblastoma (not a selection) and H3/IDH alterations are listed as eligible HGG subtypes, so not recorded as selection biomarkers. Detailed description mentions unspecified 'biomarker data'. Phase I Part B and Phase II never started.
